body:
Found and fixed: the TLS FFI block was nested inside net/tcp.prn's own #ifndef _WIN32 guard, silently compiling out on Windows. Moved it out, replaced raw poll() (not on Windows) with mbedtls_net_poll, added embedded-CA-bundle support. Commit 169e7e5.

⚓ ☃
title: fix(runtime): TLS block was dead code on Windows/mingw, plus real embedded-CA support (S508f)
